component.name: Debrid Applet
component.summary: Debrid services in one tray window

description.p: Shows account status and every torrent with live progress, adds magnets, .torrent files and hoster links, streams or downloads the results, and automates the rest: watch folder, RSS feeds, auto-download, local API.
Tray icon on Cinnamon, KDE, XFCE, MATE and GNOME (with the AppIndicator extension); works as a plain window elsewhere.

screenshot.caption: The All tab with items from every service

description.p: Flatpak build for Flathub: players and downloads run on the host or fall back to the browser and the built-in wget; app id io.github.xb00tt.debrid-applet.
App id is io.github.xb00tt.debrid-applet, the form Flathub maps to the repository; metainfo within Flathub's quality guidelines; install.sh never stops on store data.
Runs on any Debian-based desktop: tray icon on Cinnamon, KDE, XFCE, MATE and GNOME, plain window elsewhere.
